items.title: Benny Golson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: me and the piano. I said, oh, man. But when I finished it, he says, “Oh, that’s beautiful. What is it?” I said, “I don’t have a title yet, but I’m thinking of calling it I Remember Clifford.” I told him I Remember Clifford. He said, “I’ve got a record date coming up with Norman Granz in about a month. Can I record this?” Dizzy Gillespie’s asking me, can he record my song? He didn’t know that in Philadelphia, when I was in high school, I had his picture on the wall at the foot of my bed. Every morning I’d wake up…
